banner.bannerDescriptionFirstLine: There are many ways to get help. It’s easier than you might think.

gettingHelpPageContent.listTitle1: According to Gambling Help Online, indicators that gambling moved beyond being a social activity can include:
gettingHelpPageContent.list1:
• Struggling to control gambling impulses despite negative consequences in other areas of life;
  • Spending more money on gambling than is planned;
  • Spending more time gambling than is planned.
gettingHelpPageContent.contentLine1: At the Gambling Help Online website, you can see how your gambling compares to other Australians by using a gambling calculator and complete a self-assessment do determine the risk your gambling poses.

faceToFaceHelpPageContent.contentLine1: If you think you need help, gambling counselling organisations offer support and strategies to help you take back control.
faceToFaceHelpPageContent.contentLine2: Counselling allows you to talk about the impact gambling has had on your life in a safe, confidential and non-judgmental environment.
faceToFaceHelpPageContent.list1:
• Experienced and free face-to-face counselling;
  • Financial counselling and advice;
  • Phone and online support;
  • Online resources and tools;
  • Access to peer support groups.
faceToFaceHelpPageContent.listTitle2: A great place to start is the Gambling Help Online website or the responsible gambling foundation in your state.
faceToFaceHelpPageContent.list2:
• Experienced and free face-to-face counselling;
  • Financial counselling and advice;
  • Phone and online support;
  • Online resources and tools;
  • Access to peer support groups.

helpByPhonePageContent.contentLine1: If you are experiencing difficulties in controlling your gambling, immediate help is available by calling Gambling Help Online on 1800 858 858.
helpByPhonePageContent.contentLine2: CrownBet customers can also access free and confidential counselling through the Crown Melbourne Responsible Gambling Support Centre by calling 1800 801 098.

chaplaincyPageContent.contentLine1: CrownBet customers also have access to an inter-faith Chaplaincy service provided by Crown Melbourne.
chaplaincyPageContent.contentLine2: The Chaplaincy Support Service is available to customers and staff and remains faithful to the tradition of community service found in all religious teachings.
chaplaincyPageContent.contentLine3: The Chaplaincy Support Service enables people to seek guidance and peace in their own way and aims to be relevant to the particular issues and life situations of the individual.
chaplaincyPageContent.contentLine4: This service is free and confidential and can be arranged by phoning Fr James Grant on 1800 456 228.

financialCounsellingPageContent.contentLine1:
An important step in overcoming difficulties with gambling is a focus on financial management.

Community organisations can provide information about how to better manage your financial position and avoid any further harm as well as provide assistance in accessing further services to help.

To find out more about financial counselling, phone Gambler’s Help on 1800 858 858.
